caption: The drawing depicts a single arch-shaped object resembling a stone or plaque with a smooth, rounded top and a rectangular base. Inside the arch, there is a simple, stylized outline of an elephant with a curved trunk facing to the left and four legs visible. Above the elephant, in the upper half of the arch, there are faint, hand-drawn uppercase letters and words scattered across the surface. The composition is monochromatic, using varying shades of gray and black lines for the outlines and shading. The base of the arch is decorated with a series of 'X' patterns arranged in two horizontal rows. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Tombstone
